canonical_definition: The property of a model's internal computations, particularly attention scores, to remain within a stable, predictable range and avoid issues like exploding or vanishing values.
expert_removed_reason: method/engineering: numerical range of internal computations (exploding/vanishing attention scores, overflow) is an implementation property, not an LLM ability, disposition or quality (cf. EXPERT_REMOVED Attention sparsity).
